prompt_exact.base:
Detailed naturalistic pixel-art environmental illustration for ChirpNeighbors. Deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, carefully shaded small material details, restrained natural Southern California palette, warm upper-left light, subtle organic outlines, no heavy black cartoon outlines, no painterly blur, no oversaturated ornament. Landscape game background with slightly elevated side-on three-quarter yard perspective, never overhead isometric. Keep very calm low-contrast background, simple large masses, clear depth and a large uncluttered central ground stage for small birds and user-placeable objects. No birds, no animals, no people, no text, no logos, no UI, no installed feeder or bath. No generic fantasy garden.

Create one wide 3:2 opaque background: an ordinary marine-influenced San Diego coastal urban/suburban yard. Pale warm stucco rear boundary at mid depth, distant modest rooflines and muted blue-green planted canopy well below a pale blue sky, very subtle marine haze. Dry cream decomposed-granite ground transitioning to a few pale pavers at lower right. Sparse low native garden bed masses confined to far left and far right edges. Soft sage greens, cream, desaturated teal; late morning diffuse coastal light. Horizon around 40 percent height. Leave the middle 60 percent of the lower half quiet and open, without decorative centerpieces. No ocean vista, no coastal cliff, no rainforest.

The delivered file is one flattened opaque base image, not a separated layer set. Independently generated foreground overlays will be separate files later.

Approved written style only; no visual reference image supplied. Target 1536 by 1024 pixels, crisp deliberate pixel art.
prompt_exact.overlay:
Generate one transparent foreground edge overlay, NOT a complete scene. True transparent alpha background everywhere except the small foreground objects. No sky, no background wall, no floor plane, no opaque rectangle, no matte, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork. Landscape canvas 1536 x 1024. Keep the top 70 percent of the canvas and middle 65 percent fully empty/transparent. Grounded vegetation and material details hug the bottom-left and bottom-right corners only, leaving all center bird staging space free. Upper-left warm lighting. Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART using a coherent low-resolution 384 x 256 logical pixel grid enlarged exactly 4x nearest-neighbor: visible square stepped silhouettes and deliberate larger pixel clusters, flat stepped shading, subtle organic outlines, limited restrained Southern California palette. NO smooth gradients, NO high-resolution painterly brush stipple, NO photorealistic texture, NO blurry antialiasing. Preserve natural believable form and material detail. No birds, no animals, no humans, no text, no UI, no labels. The supplied yard image is a composition/palette guide only; generate only the foreground overlay and do not reproduce the yard.

Bottom-left small low muted sage-green broad-leaf shrub fringe with a few pale cream flower clusters and two rounded sandy pebbles. Bottom-right a very small chalky blue-green succulent rosette and one pale irregular stone. Corner masses modest, each no more than 18 percent of width and 22 percent of height. Bottom crop is intentional, upright plants not cut on side edges. Coastal garden overlay, not a new plant species plate.
